name: Sarith al-Vey
source_profile:
Elder Sarith al-Vey (LN)

Sarith is an austere and scholarly leader who regards the Cadorian land rush as a threat not simply to Veyrathi territory, but to the historical treasures and sacred places under his people's protection. He advocates maintaining the Coalition principally as a defensive arrangement while discouraging direct contact with settlers. Sarith strongly opposes sharing the locations of Veyrathi ruins, ancient roads, or buried settlements with outsiders.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 70 (source excerpt; may be partial)
